Usage: gaia extract result [OPTIONS] TASK_ID

 Fetch what an LKM extraction task produced.

 GET /parse/task/{task_id}/result.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    task_id      TEXT  Extraction task id returned by `gaia extract         │
│                         submit`.                                             │
│                         [required]                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --index,--server        TEXT  Configured LKM index id. [default: bohrium]    │
│ --format                TEXT  Succeeded result shape: local (flat graph) or  │
│                               graph (same as lkm package).                   │
│                               [default: local]                               │
│ --out                   PATH  Write JSON to PATH (atomic) instead of stdout. │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:
 gaia extract result <task_id>
 gaia extract result <task_id> --format graph
 What you have:
 a succeeded task, flat graph   ->  --format local (default)
 a succeeded task, nodes/edges  ->  --format graph
 still queued or running        ->  status, not result
 a non-null global_id           ->  gaia search lkm nodes / pkg add
 Default `--format local` is `variables` / `factors` / `motivations` / `stats`
 under `data`. `--format graph` matches `gaia search lkm package` (`paper` +
 `addressed_problems` + `open_questions` + `graph.nodes` / `graph.edges`),
 where `paper` is null unless the extraction was reused from a corpus paper.
 Format only applies to succeeded results; an unknown value exits 4 before any
 request.
 A succeeded envelope also carries `task_id`, `status`, `cache_hit`,
 `cache_source`, and `step_durations`. Status responses do not include the
 cache fields.
 Node `local_id` values and graph node `id`s are file-local. Only a non-null
 `global_id` is an LKM id you can pass to `gaia search lkm nodes` or `gaia pkg
 add`.
 Queued or running: 290017, exit 1 — the task is not lost. `partial` is a
 non-retryable business failure; do not resubmit the same PDF or `--content`
 body. Empty `files` on partial is expected.
